summary: Entrenched power and systems also hurt #prosocialweb. Web is thirty years old. Every industry is a tech industry.. Yet how many departments in #HigherEd have someone in that field who knows web and tech.... It's usually zero... How does that happen?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Entrenched power and systems also hurt #prosocialweb.

Web is thirty years old. Every industry is a tech industry.. Yet how many departments in #HigherEd have someone in that field who knows web and tech.... It's usually zero...

How does that happen?
